scope.included: COM registrations and X7 object-model members directly used by the v0.5 bridge, plus the immediate read-only inspection dependencies approved for Phase 2.
scope.excluded: The complete X7 object model, members not yet mapped to an approved tool, and any newer-version-only API.
scope.warning: Member existence in documentation or the type library does not prove runtime behavior. Live verification remains separate.

evidence_sources.description: Registered 64-bit CorelDRAW X7 type library inspected through pythoncom/pywin32 without invoking COM methods. The registered library version is hexadecimal 0x11, which is decimal 17.
HKCR registration confirms CorelDRAW.Application.17 and generic CorelDRAW.Application both map to CLSID {2FBA0002-B5E2-C3B0-412E-C843C16BAFDB}; generic CurVer is CorelDRAW.Application.17.
Catalog-foundation baseline retaining the historical v0.5 dynamic Caption read.
Read-only inspection of installed X7 text members with connection_attempted false.
Installed X7 transform/order signatures read without connecting to the application.
Template copy/page/ownership/close signatures; no live application connection.
126 retained PDF descriptors and 14 enums; no native application connection.
Installed X7 curve/node/shaping signatures and enums, read without application access.

notes: Preferred and attempted first by the X7 compatibility adapter.
Connected applications are rejected unless major version 17 is detected.
Retained as a fallback after the explicit X7 ProgID.
The adapter validates major version 17 instead of trusting generic CurVer.
Caption was not found on the official X7 Application class page or installed X7 type-library property map.
The unconfirmed dynamic read was removed from corel_status in bridge 0.6.0.
Used only to construct a synthetic disposable contour fixture; it is not exposed as an MCP tool.
Behavior for unsaved documents must be tested before relying on a non-empty path.
Used only as a fallback when ActivePage.ActiveLayer cannot be read.
Temporary unit changes must be restored after an operation except for a newly created document's explicit setup.
Uses the document's existing PDFSettings; successful return does not establish print readiness.
Created exactly one sized output page during the guarded disposable imposition regression.
Used only as a targeted rollback fallback for the newly appended output page.
A forced post-placement discrepancy deleted only the newly created output page and preserved the source plus the prior successful output page.
